title: Our First Meeting
description: Before your cousin's interview started, we met through mutual friends. What began as a simple introduction slowly became the start of a meaningful friendship.

title: The Interview Day
description: We worked together to help your cousin prepare for the interview. Sharing ideas and supporting each other made that day memorable.

title: Staying Connected
description: After the interview, we continued talking and getting to know each other better through regular conversations.

title: Instagram Friends
description: We followed each other on Instagram and started sharing reels, memes, and little moments from our daily lives.

title: Best Friends Era
description: What started as a simple friendship grew stronger day by day. Through endless chats, shared reels, laughter, support, and unforgettable memories, we became best friends.
